Note: [64 bytes] Table with possible level orders (8x8 bytes)

[8-bit] Per-scene ID, one value for each minigame, the intro card and the menus (used for "actually in gameplay")
0x00 = Stage intro card and transitions
0x01 = Forest, and briefly at every stage start
0x02 = Snowboard 
0x03 = Swimmer
0x04 / 0x05 = Title / menu
0x0a = Ice cave
0x0b = Ice cave symbol door
0x0c = Endgame part 2
0x0d = Witch endgame
0x0e = Ending

[8-bit] Cheat indicator
0=no cheat
1=infinite lives
2=harmless logs in forest
